name: Sphere Collision Hero
description: Full-screen hero with a 3D cluster of pink spheres that fly in, settle into a breathing formation and repel from the cursor, with a reveal of nav, big labels and social links on top.
contents: Fixed WebGL canvas with about 100 spheres of varied radius
Large centered brand title shown during the intro
Header with brand link, nav links and mobile menu button
Corner labels, tagline, description block, social icon links and rotated hint text
behavior: Spheres rise from below in a staggered looping arc and settle into place
After the intro the overlay text fades in and the center title fades out
Hovering spheres pushes them away, with collision resolution between spheres
Drag to orbit the camera with damping
Custom cursor follows the mouse on large screens
editableByProps: All text, nav links, social links and icons
Sphere color, emissive color, background gradient and text color
Camera distance and field of view, light intensities
Intro duration and stagger, breathing and repulsion strength

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the intro arc height or start depth
Change the nav underline or right label bar

fixed: Fixed full-viewport canvas, cursor layer and centered intro title are positioned against the viewport
Hides the system-independent custom cursor only below the lg breakpoint, the system cursor is not hidden
Font Awesome icon classes and Oswald font are loaded through CSS imports in the STYLES constant
Sphere intro reveal timing is fixed to revolutionDur + 1 seconds
Rotated hint text is hidden below the md breakpoint
